name: Goodyear Credit Card
network: PROPRIETARY (Goodyear / Citi Retail Services, closed-loop, not Visa or Mastercard)
effective_cost: Free, with no annual fee, but purely a store-financing tool with no rewards and no use outside Goodyear and its fuel-station partners

welcome_bonus.bonus: $50 back, paid by prepaid physical or virtual card via online or mail-in rebate
welcome_bonus.requirement: on a first qualifying purchase of $250 or more (before tax) with a new Goodyear Credit Card account; offer valid 6/1/2025-12/31/2026

verdict.text: A tire financing card, not rewards: for buys you can pay off in 6 months

earn_note: This card has no cash-back or points program. Its value proposition is deferred-interest financing ("no interest if paid in full within 6 months" on purchases of $250+) plus periodic rebates on tire purchases. Unlike Citi's Best Buy or Wayfair co-brands, no open-loop Visa/Mastercard version of this card exists; it's a single, closed-loop product usable only at Goodyear's roughly 17,000 locations and about 11,500 participating Exxon and Mobil fuel stations.

points.note: No points or cash back exist on this card. Its value is the 6-month deferred-interest offer on purchases of $250 or more. If the balance isn't paid in full by the deadline, interest is charged back to the purchase date at the card's 33.74% variable APR.

transfer_partners.highlight: No rewards currency exists on this card, so there is nothing to transfer.

protection_note: None of the usual card protections apply: this is a closed-loop retail financing account, not a Visa or Mastercard, so there's no purchase protection, extended warranty, or travel insurance. Citi lists $0 liability on unauthorized charges and identity theft protection.
rental_note: No rental car coverage; this card can't be used for rentals or anywhere outside Goodyear locations and participating Exxon/Mobil stations.

services.name: Deferred-interest financing
services.detail: No interest if paid in full within 6 months on purchases of $250 or more; interest accrues retroactively from the purchase date if the balance isn't cleared by the deadline.

services.name: Usable at partner fuel stations
services.detail: Accepted at over 17,000 Goodyear locations plus roughly 11,500 participating Exxon and Mobil fuel stations nationwide, broader than a typical single-retailer store card, but still closed-loop.

services.name: Periodic tire rebates
services.detail: Exclusive cardholder-only savings on select Goodyear tire purchases, offered periodically.

services.name: Identity theft protection
services.detail: Listed by Citi among the card's benefits.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users
additional_cards.note: No distinct authorized-user program or benefit was found for this card; it's a single-purpose store-financing account.

timeline.text: Unlike Citi's Best Buy, Wayfair and Macy's co-brands, Goodyear has no open-loop network-branded counterpart; this closed-loop card is the only product offered. Its value comes from deferred-interest financing on tire and service purchases, not from earning rewards.
